definitions.explanation: The line along the top of a mountain ridge, especially as seen outlined against the sky.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{稜線|りょうせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
examples.english: The ridgeline of the mountains is beautiful.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夕日|ゆうひ}→夕日：04080_yuuhi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{稜線|りょうせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{向|む}こう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{沈|しず}んで→沈む：02061_shizumu⟧いった。
examples.english: The evening sun sank behind the ridge.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山頂|さんちょう}→山頂：09942_sanchou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{稜線|りょうせん}{沿|ぞ}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{両側|りょうがわ}→両側：28877_ryougawa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{雲海|うんかい}→雲海：18222_unkai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっていた→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: Walking along the ridge from the summit, we saw a sea of clouds spread out on both sides.

notes:
USAGE:
A written and hiking word. In landscape writing it is the outline of mountains against the sky; for climbers it is the ridge route itself ({稜線|りょうせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{稜線|りょうせん}: the mountains' ridgeline
- {稜線|りょうせん}{沿|ぞ}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: along the ridge
- {稜線|りょうせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{浮|う}かび{上|あ}がる→浮かび上がる：06858_ukabiagaru⟧: the ridge stands out (against the sky)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{尾根|おね}→尾根：19839_one⟧: ridge, the everyday word for the landform; {稜線|りょうせん} stresses the line it draws.
